question: What is the proposal submission deadline in the Teachers' Retirement System of Oklahoma investment consultant RFP?
acceptance: January 14, 2026, 4pm Central Time. CT or CST acceptable for the January date.
candidate_answer: The proposal submission deadline is **January 14, 2026, by 4:00 p.m. Central Time**. Late proposals will not be considered. [Oklahoma TRS Investment Consultant RFP, p. 15](Oklahoma_TRS__Investment.Consultant.RFP.adopted.by.Board.pdf)
